notes:
Document is 2 pages. Page 1 contains Semester One through Six; page 2 contains Semester Seven and Eight at the top, followed by the Graduation Requirements Summary table, numbered footnotes, Program Notes, University Requirements, and Codes legend (all excluded per instructions, per "Only the semester tables"). Note: this PDF's underlying text layer, if extracted linearly, interleaves the Semester Seven/Eight tables in a confusing order relative to the trailing legend/footnote content; the visual rendering (used for this transcription) confirms Semester Seven and Eight tables sit at the top of page 2, before all excluded prose.

Excluded "Progression:" banner lines: these are full-width annotations between semester blocks with no Credit/Grade/Code columns filled in (unlike placeholder rows such as "Carolina Core Requirement6" which do carry real column data). I treated them as out-of-scope narrative, analogous to Program Notes, rather than as course-placeholder rows, since the row schema requires a credits value and these lines have none. For completeness, the omitted banners were: "Prepare for and take Praxis Core exams if SAT or ACT minimum score not met" (after Sem 2), "Take and pass the EEDA Assessment on Blackboard" (after Sem 3), "Apply for Professional Program (all requirements for Professional Program must be met by July 15 prior to fifth semester)1" (after Sem 4), "Apply for Internship and SC Teacher Licensure" (after Sem 6), "Take required PLT Certification exams during senior year" (after Sem 7), "Apply for Initial Certification" (after Sem 8). A parser that surfaces these as pseudo-rows would disagree with this gold standard by design.

Codes column: several rows print two stacked Carolina Core codes in one cell (e.g., ENGL 102 shows "CC-CMW" then "CC-INF" on the next line; DANC 478 and DANC 479 show "MR" then "CC-INT"). Per the row-wrapping rule these were joined into one space-separated string: "CC-CMW CC-INF" and "MR CC-INT" respectively.

The document's "Major GPA" column (footnote 2) is present in the header but is blank for every single row on both pages — no course in this particular major map is flagged as counting toward major GPA. There is no schema field for it, so nothing was recorded, but a parser should not expect any non-null values there for this document.

Header block reads "Major Map: Dance / Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) / Dance Education (K-12) Concentration / McCausland College of Arts and Sciences / Department of Theatre and Dance / Bulletin Year: 2026-2027." There is no dedicated schema field for "concentration," so it was folded into the major field as "Dance (Dance Education (K-12) Concentration)" — a parser emitting bare "Dance" for major is arguably still correct and should be treated as an acceptable partial match.

total_credits_required ("120") was taken from the Graduation Requirements Summary's "Minimum Total Hours" cell, which is metadata rather than a semester-table row; the summary table itself was correctly excluded from the sections array.

Verbatim fidelity notes: "DANC 103 The Dancer's Body" uses a typographic right single quotation mark (’) as printed. Footnote digits were kept fused to titles exactly as printed (e.g., "Introduction to Dance3", "Dance Company4", "Dance History I3", "Carolina Core Requirement6(only if needed to meet Carolina Core)" — note the latter has no space between "6" and "(", exactly as printed, whereas the similar Semester Seven row "Carolina Core Requirement6 or Elective11 (only if..." does have a space before its parenthetical — both reproduced verbatim). Ranged-credit rows present in this document, matching the stated selection rationale: Semester Five/Seven Carolina Core Requirement6 rows at "3-4", and Semester Six/Seven rows at "0-3". C+ minimum-grade rows are pervasive throughout (most major-requirement rows require C+; ENGL 101/102 and DANC 479/471 require plain "C").
